fusions.name: Skimming Stoop
fusions.desc: You glide up to 7 tiles to the target and strike it for 14 damage, leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Murmuration
fusions.desc: Sweeps a cone 5 tiles long ahead of you, dealing 7 damage to everything in it. Its damage rises 8% for each ally beside you, up to 32%. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Skip the Surface
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 35% for 8 seconds. You finish 2 tiles from where you stood, with 8% more dodge chance while it lasts.

fusions.name: Wave-Top Runner

riders.text: you cross it faster than you cross land
and you are off the surface before a blow lands

fusions.desc: You cross water and swamp on foot.
